verdict.rationale: CodeRabbit documents both halves of the story inside the PR. Its Finishing Touches are one-click agentic actions that fix review findings (docs-13), and suggested changes can be applied with a single click without switching contexts (docs-23, docs-61, docs-80). It also says it generates the code changes needed to fix issues on request, including on CI failures (docs-26, docs-62, docs-44), and lets you choose how fixes land (docs-81). Community discussion corroborates that it offers directly committable fixes (comm-8). Missing for 10: independent hands-on reports on the quality and reliability of the agent-generated fixes, and detail on how committed patches are attributed and pushed.
